recognize_zh: 腦部 MRI 顯示右額葉大型病灶，T1 呈低訊號、DWI 呈高訊號（擴散受限）、T2 與皮質等訊號並伴周邊水腫，注射顯影劑後明顯增強並造成中線偏移，這種細胞密度高、擴散受限的腫塊符合原發性中樞神經淋巴瘤（PCNSL）。
features: Panel A (non-contrast T1): expansile hypointense right frontal mass (arrows) compressing the frontal horn of the lateral ventricle
Panel B (DWI): hyperintense signal within the lesion indicating restricted diffusion, reflecting high cellularity
Panel C (T2): lesion roughly isointense to cortex with surrounding hyperintense vasogenic edema and mass effect
Panel D (post-contrast T1): avid, largely peripheral/heterogeneous enhancement with a periventricular component (arrows)
Deep periventricular location with subfalcine midline shift
describe_en: Axial brain MRI shows an expansile right frontal lobe mass that is hypointense on non-contrast T1-weighted imaging, isointense to cortex on T2-weighted imaging with surrounding vasogenic edema, and hyperintense on diffusion-weighted imaging with reduced apparent diffusion coefficient. After gadolinium, the lesion enhances avidly with a periventricular component and causes mass effect on the lateral ventricle with midline shift. This is a radiologic, not morphologic, image; restricted diffusion and T2 isointensity reflect a highly cellular tumor with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. Findings are suggestive of primary CNS lymphoma, requiring stereotactic biopsy (ideally before corticosteroids) and CSF cytology/flow cytometry for confirmation.

ddx.vs: GBM typically shows thick irregular rim enhancement around central necrosis with T2 hyperintensity and less uniform diffusion restriction, often crossing the corpus callosum in a butterfly pattern.
Metastases are often multiple at the gray-white junction with disproportionate edema and a known primary, and usually lack marked diffusion restriction.
Abscesses show a smooth thin enhancing rim with central (not solid) diffusion restriction and a T2-hypointense capsule.
Tumefactive MS shows incomplete (open-ring) enhancement with peripheral diffusion restriction and less mass effect than expected for size.
